properties.WarningTitle: STAY PREPARED - Lowmead and Colosseum - fire as at 6:28pm Thursday, 24 September 2026
properties.CallToAction: Stay Prepared
properties.WarningText:
*** There is more than one warning for this area. To see all current warnings, visit the Qld Fire website ***

A dangerous fast moving fire is burning near Mackellor Road.

Stay prepared as the danger from this fire will continue for days. The fire could get worse quickly.

What you should do:

- If you are in danger, call Triple Zero (000) now.

- Check for warning updates often and listen to your local radio station.

- If you need medication to help you breathe keep it close. Smoke can make it hard to breathe.

- Stay prepared so you can leave quickly if the fire gets close:

  - If you have a bushfire survival plan, follow it now.

  - Decide on a safe place to go. This may be to family or friends outside the warning area.

  - Tell others where you will go.

  - Plan how you will leave. Some roads may not be safe. You may need to drive a different way.

  - If you are not prepared or find it hard to move quickly, your safest option is to leave early.

  - Pack a bag with device chargers, clothes, important documents, medicine, lots of drinking water, cash and other important items.

  - Be ready to take your pets, their food and supplies.

  - Wear protective clothing that covers your skin.

- Do not fly drones around the fire as they affect firefighting.

Impacts:

- Roads may be impacted by smoke. Smoke can make it hard to see when driving.

- Power, water, phone, and internet services may be impacted as the fire gets closer.

What firefighters are doing:

- Firefighters are working to control the fire.

- Heavy machinery are helping ground crews.

- Backburning is being done to help control the fire.

Support and recovery help:

- For power information go to the website.

- For local information visit your Council’s Local Disaster Dashboard.

- If you need translation, call TIS National on 131 450.

- Natural disasters can affect your mental health. If you need help contact:

  - Lifeline website or call 13 11 14.

  - Beyond Blue website or call 1300 224 636.

  - Kids Helpline website or call 1800 551 800.

More information:

- For all fire warnings, visit the Qld Fire website.

- Follow Queensland Fire Department on Facebook.

- For road closures, visit the QLD Traffic website or call 13 19 40.

- Learn how to get ready for a bushfire on the Qld Fire website - Prepare - Bushfire.

This fire is expected to keep burning for days. Updates will be issued if the situation changes.

This warning is from the Queensland Fire Department.
